# ALNA Systems

ALNA Systems is a decision and implementation support platform for organizations delivering mental health, social care, rehabilitation, community, and other human services. It connects operational data, the service journey, organizational context, and the perspectives of frontline teams, middle managers, and senior leaders.

The purpose is to help organizations understand where service delivery is breaking down, examine several plausible mechanisms, compare feasible actions, and learn from implementation. ALNA does not make decisions on behalf of the organization. It supports professional judgment with a structured diagnostic process and a record of what was recommended, chosen, implemented, and observed.

ALNA is not a case management system, a clinical system, a dashboard, or a generic AI product. It can work alongside existing systems and may include technology or automation as one possible part of an intervention when the evidence and organizational context support it.

The public website is available in English and Hebrew. English pages are under `/en/`; Hebrew pages are at the root.

## English pages

- [Home](https://alnasystems.com/en/): overview of ALNA, the service diagnostic process, implementation support, sectors, and frequently asked questions.
- [Service Diagnostic](https://alnasystems.com/en/process-improvement.html): the focused diagnostic and improvement service for complex service pathways.
- [How ALNA Thinks](https://alnasystems.com/en/how-alna-thinks.html): the reasoning model from finding to possible mechanism, action, implementation, outcome, and learning.
- [Fit Check](https://alnasystems.com/en/fit-check.html): questions that help an organization decide whether a focused diagnostic conversation could be useful.
- [Knowledge Hub](https://alnasystems.com/en/knowledge-hub.html): articles on organizational mechanisms and implementation.
- [Same Problem, Different Causes, Different Actions](https://alnasystems.com/en/knowledge/matching-intervention-to-mechanism.html): matching an intervention to evidence, context, and the possible mechanism.
- [Why a Good Recommendation Can Still Fail](https://alnasystems.com/en/knowledge/why-good-recommendations-fail.html): the gap between a decision and implementation.
- [Did the Change Fail, or Was It Not Implemented?](https://alnasystems.com/en/knowledge/implementation-or-wrong-hypothesis.html): separating implementation fidelity from outcome.
- [Illustrative Report](https://alnasystems.com/en/sample-report.html): a fictional English report showing findings, a possible mechanism, recommendation state, organizational decision, implementation measures, and outcome measures.
- [About](https://alnasystems.com/en/about.html): the professional background and approach behind ALNA.
- [Privacy Policy](https://alnasystems.com/en/privacy-policy.html)
- [Accessibility Statement](https://alnasystems.com/en/accessibility.html)

## Core English positioning

ALNA serves leaders responsible for services, programs, quality, innovation, and organizational improvement. It is especially relevant where multidisciplinary work and complex pathways affect continuity, access, progression, or wellbeing.

Working sequence: service diagnostic, possible mechanisms, action alternatives, organization decision, implementation, outcome review, and organizational learning.

## Hebrew overview

ALNA Systems היא פלטפורמת אבחון וליווי לארגוני טיפול, רווחה, שיקום ושירותים חברתיים. הפלטפורמה מחברת בין נתונים תפעוליים, מסע השירות, ההקשר הארגוני והידע של אנשי המקצוע. המטרה היא להבין מה קורה בתהליך, אילו מנגנונים עשויים להסביר את הפערים, מה כדאי לנסות, ומה ניתן ללמוד לאחר היישום.
